title: Engine key file
description: <stateDir>/channel.json: the engine's signing key and box key. Mode 0600, owned by the engine's OS user, written atomically. A file that fails this schema, whose engineId does not match signingKey, or whose boxKeySig does not verify is never replaced: the channel stays off and status reports vault.state KEY_ERROR. See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Engine keys.

engineId.description: base64url of the first 16 bytes of sha256(signing public key, SPKI DER).

createdAt.description: When these keys were made (RFC 3339 UTC).

signingKey.description: The ECDSA P-256 private key, PKCS#8 DER, base64url without padding. Signs only the contexts listed in CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Primitives and encodings.

boxKey.description: The ECDH P-256 private key, PKCS#8 DER, base64url without padding. Used only for ECDH (Phase 1b envelopes).

boxKeySig.description: Signature (64 bytes r||s, base64url) by the signing key over "basalt-engine-box-key.1\n" + engineId + "\n" + box public key SPKI base64url.

rotatedFrom.description: The latest rotation, present when the old key file was valid at basalt engine rotate-key. The old private key is not kept.

signingKey.description: The old signing public key, SPKI DER, base64url.

at.description: When the rotation happened; part of the signed statement.

sig.description:
Signature by the old key over "basalt-engine-rotate.1
" + old engineId + "
" + new signing key SPKI + "
" + new box key SPKI + "
" + at (keys base64url).
